title: Message redelivery: repeated delivery is not repeated business work
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Redeliver one message; distinguish repeated delivery from repeated business effects.
sourceAcceptance: Preserve one business effect even when the broker delivers a message again.
parentAcceptance: Redelivered messages produce one intended effect; duplicates and unresolved outcomes remain visible.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser; no broker, server, subscription, credentials or installation.
One in-memory synthetic message MSG-077 and stable business key ORDER-077:credit.
One intended credit of 10 synthetic units; first delivery remains unacknowledged.
Explicit modeled lock expiry permits exactly one additional delivery; no timer or real settlement.
actions: Choose ledger protection or blind application and the first business outcome.
Deliver the message and inspect the first delivery and any known effect.
Expire the modeled lock, then redeliver the same message once.
Compare delivery and business-effect ledgers; interpret PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN.
Retain up to six attempts or explicitly reset all in-memory state and history.
trace: At most two deliveries, two known business effects and six immutable in-memory attempt histories.
assertions: Ledger protection suppresses a known duplicate while retaining the second delivery.
Blind application after a known first commit exposes two effects and FAIL.
Observed failure before commit still produces one effect on redelivery.
Unresolved first effects stay UNKNOWN, including after a known blind reapplication.
Known effects, duplicate effects and unresolved outcomes are counted separately.
Wrong order, forged state, invalid enum or additional input cannot advance state.
Correct learner interpretation never rewrites failed effects or retained history.
Actual DOM, keyboard, errors, reset, failure, unknown and enforced CSP are checked.
limits: Deterministic in-memory rules only; no actual broker lock expiry, settlement or redelivery.
The ledger handler is a teaching rule, not atomic or durable business-effect storage.
No actual broker redelivery, idempotency or durable business-effect certification.
B-S077 and D-S077 remain incomplete; native identity, atomicity, recovery and redelivery need their own proof.
Not replacement S075 consumer expansion, S076 retirement, S078 scheduler fencing or S084 command idempotency.
No production Node24, native/source-parent, five-nines or unattended browser lifecycle certification.
Published browser helper only; abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified.
File-origin Worker rejection precedes CSP; worker-src enforcement is not independently qualified.
Synthetic data only; no cloud, IaC, credentials, deployment, downloads, installs or spending.
One frozen S unit; tests, plumbing and refinement earn no additional credit.
